brian: `./infra/tools/keys reissue --service prober --region eu-west --reason="token-rollover-fix"`
brian: `ssh runner-12 && sudo systemctl restart redwood-prober.service`
infra-team-bot: runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/prober-503 (follow steps: rotate client key -> restart prober -> monitor)

sre_oncall: handoff recorded to elaine for 2h
elaine: ack, monitoring for recurrence. I'll escalate if failures >3 within 10m or if user errors appear.
incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation cleared (service: synth-probes) — pages suppressed, monitoring continues :white_check_mark:
maria: quick customer-impact check: no user-facing 5xx spikes in prod logs, no increase in error reports. Marking impact: none observed. I'll run synthetic smoke across related endpoints to be safe.
brian: adding brief incident note to the incident board and tagging for postmortem: cause=auth-proxy-token-rollover; action=improve token rollout/coordination
elaine: closing thread here, will reopen if we see recurrence. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
